response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios, SUM(g.cnt) AS total_records, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
